name: @onlyoffice/apps-ui-kit
//sync: Refresh the vendored assets from a DocSpace client checkout. Run by hand when the upstream strings or icons change, then commit the result -- never wired into build, test or lint, because this package has to work with no DocSpace next to it. Point DOCSPACE_CLIENT_ROOT at the checkout if it is not ../../DocSpace/client. `sync-locales` overwrites every language it finds; only locales/en is committed.

scripts.sync-assets: pnpm run sync-locales && pnpm run sync-images
scripts.build: pnpm run clean && rollup -c && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/normalize-types.mjs && node scripts/finalize-dist.mjs && node scripts/check-dist.mjs
scripts.prepare: node -e "if (!process.env.CI) { try { require('child_process').execSync('git --version', {stdio: 'ignore'}); require('child_process').execSync('lefthook install', {stdio: 'inherit'}); } catch (e) { console.error('Lefthook installation skipped:', e.message); } }"
scripts.test:e2e:docker:start: docker-compose run --rm tests-local pnpm exec playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:docker:update-screenshots: docker-compose run --rm tests-local pnpm exec playwright test --update-snapshots
scripts.test:e2e:docker:dev: docker-compose run --rm tests-dev pnpm exec playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:docker:dev:update-screenshots: docker-compose run --rm tests-dev pnpm exec playwright test --update-snapshots
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run storybook-build && pnpm exec playwright test

//peerDependencies: Only packages this library imports directly. Transitive dependencies of @onlyoffice/ai-chat (the assistant-ui, radix, codemirror, LLM-vendor SDKs and friends) are declared by ai-chat itself as its own peers -- re-declaring them here duplicated a list nothing kept in sync. Everything below is verified imported somewhere under this package root.
//peerDependenciesMeta: react, react-dom, i18next and react-i18next are required -- the core components do not work without them. The rest are optional because they back a portal-internal module a consumer may never import: ai-agent (ai-chat, markdown/katex stack), billing and selectors (mobx, react-router), providers/api (axios), utils/socket (socket.io), document-editor.
//devDependencies: Mirrors every non-required peerDependency: pnpm does not install peers, so the build, tests and Storybook need a concrete copy here. Transitive peers of @onlyoffice/ai-chat are deliberately absent -- pnpm resolves those into ai-chat's own node_modules from the declarations in its package.json.
//publishConfig.exports: One wildcard serves every module subpath, including the *.types and *.svg ones that used to need patterns of their own. The build emits a single shape -- rollup via `entryFileNames`, tsc declarations via scripts/normalize-types.mjs -- so `<subpath>/index.*` is the only layout there is. This replaced 916 generated entries and the script that wrote them; see the comment in rollup.config.mjs for why a mixed-shape tree cannot be served by a wildcard at all. Note: this note cannot live inside `exports` itself -- Node rejects an exports object that mixes subpath keys with non-'.' keys (ERR_INVALID_PACKAGE_CONFIG), since a key not starting with '.' marks the whole object as a conditions-only main entry. There is deliberately no `./*.scss` pattern: rollup compiles every component-local CSS module into a class-name map, so `components/article/Article.module.scss` is a *directory* holding an index.js in dist and the plain `./*` wildcard serves it -- dist ships no .scss file at all. Raw Sass sources stay reachable through `./styles/*`, which is the form every `@use` in the portal writes.
